source_title: Pixel Watch 5 matches all-time low price on Amazon
source_excerpt:
Black Friday is still weeks away, but holiday tech discounts are already arriving early. Joining the recent price drops across Google’s flagship hardware lineup, the Google Pixel Watch 5 has once again hit its lowest price ever on Amazon.
Whether you’re looking for the compact model or prefer more screen real estate, the entry-level 41mm Wi-Fi model is down to $299.99 (from $399.99), while the larger 45mm Pixel Watch 5 Wi-Fi model has dropped its price to $329.99 (from $429.99).
If you want the freedom to leave your phone behind while running errands, working out, or taking calls, the cellular models are seeing some of the best value drops of the season. The price drops are equally sharp, bringing the 41mm LTE variant down to $399.99 (from $499.99) and the 45mm LTE variant to $429.99 (from $529.99). What’s helpful is that you can get these deals at Best Buy too, if you’d prefer to pick one up there.
Unlike typical pre-Black Friday sales that restrict discounts to specific colors, this deal applies across all standard finishes. You can pick up the sale pricing in Obsidian, Porcelain, and Hazel across both sizes, as well as Rose Quartz on the 41mm model.
If you’ve been waiting to upgrade your Wear OS setup or pair a new smartwatch with your Pixel phone, these early Black Friday prices match historical lows across the board.
There are even replica pocket charger options now cropping up if you want to have a portable USB-C compatible keychain adapter for the wearable, now just $12.79 too , with a 20% discount coupon.
The deals extend to the Pixel 11 series too, with the Pixel 11 now priced at just $699 , while the Pixel 11 Pro can be snapped up for just $799 in this early deal spree.
